name: project-proposal-analyser
description: Flue 2.0 agent that analyses newly filed GitHub issues against repo context and past hand-written reviews, publishes the analysis to a Google Doc, and links it from Discord and the issue itself.

scripts.verify: npm run fmt:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run agent:faux
scripts.agent:faux: rm -rf node_modules/.cache/flue && FLUE_FAUX=1 GITHUB_REPOSITORY=acme/widget GITHUB_TOKEN=faux flue run src/agents/issue-analyst.ts --id 1 --message 'Analyse issue #1' --json
